name: Timeline
summary: Logical-axis vertical timeline primitive with connected generated markers, resilient entry metadata, and semantic current, completed, delayed, warning, and error states.

anatomy.name: metadata
anatomy.description: Optional row grouping the date and visible status text.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Consumer-authored visible status text that supplements marker color.

states.name: current
states.description: Current entry in a sequential process.

states.name: delayed
states.description: Entry that is behind its expected schedule.

states.name: warning
states.description: Entry that requires attention without representing a failure.

states.name: error
states.description: Entry that failed or contains an error.

behavior.name: orderedContent
behavior.description: Targets preserve ordered-list semantics when chronology or sequence is meaningful.

behavior.name: singleCurrentItem
behavior.description: When the timeline represents current progress, the target applies aria-current to at most one current entry.

behavior.name: visibleStatus
behavior.description: When status meaning matters, consumers provide localized visible text so marker color is not the only signal.

behavior.name: repeatedContent
behavior.description: The consumer owns the repeated dates, status labels, titles, and descriptions; Studio sample entries are fixtures rather than component defaults.

behavior.name: logicalResponsiveLayout
behavior.description: Logical inline properties mirror markers and connectors in RTL, while every content part wraps within the component container.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Semantic state for one timeline entry. Default removes explicit status presentation.

accessibility: Use list semantics when timeline order matters.
Apply aria-current only to the current item when the timeline represents progress.
Use visible localized status text when completed, delayed, warning, or error meaning must be communicated.
Do not rely on marker color alone to communicate entry status.
Choose a title element whose heading level fits the surrounding document; the title class does not mandate h4.
Preserve logical-axis geometry in left-to-right and right-to-left content and allow extreme localized content to wrap.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition and generated markers in components/css/primitives.css.
